form.narrative: Side swiped by an auto rickshaw on a narrow road. The driver had not consumed any alcohol and the breath test at the scene was negative.

photo.description: The front bumper, hood, and headlamp of the red car are severely damaged with parts missing and visible deformation.
photo.summary: This image shows a red car with significant damage to its rear, including a crushed trunk and bent tail lights. The car is parked in a garage with a concrete floor. The garage has shelves on the right side with various items stored on them, including boxes and tools. There is a yellow and black striped line on the floor near the car. Another vehicle is partially visible in the background on the left side of the image.
